articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) has executed an MSA with a new client, DNA Fund, which provides for 576 Nvidia H200 GPUs over a two-year term. The contract represents an aggregate revenue opportunity of approximately $20.2 million for Bit Digital and is expected to commence in January 2025.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Executes MSA for 576 H200 GPU Deal with DNA AI Compute Fund

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) announced today that is has acquired the real estate and building for a build-to-suit 5MW Tier-3 data center expansion project in Montreal, Canada.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Acquires Another Metropolitan Site for Tier-3 Data Center Expansion

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT) announced its unaudited digital asset production, High-Performance Computing (HPC) revenue, and corporate updates for the month of November 2024.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Monthly Production Update for November 2024
